note: Every instrument of the room. The generator places a node INS_<id> for each; the viewer reads the same file to animate it. 'field' names a column of the crew row, the sensor view of the tick the playhead is on; 'rule' is evaluated on that row. No instrument reads a plant value the control room did not have.

derived_fields.rods_mean: mean of the rods array (percent inserted), computed by the viewer
derived_fields.model_risk: the expected risk rating (1 to 5) of the latest decision, computed by the viewer
derived_fields.az5, prot, test, pumps, ar_on: the crew row: the sensor view of the tick, from the trace row's crew record

instruments.label: POWER CH A
instruments.what: Power channel A, from the ionisation chambers, in percent of nominal.
instruments.range: 0 to 150 %, red above the 120 % power trip
instruments.modelled: As the decider is given it: the reading of the run's sensor view at this tick.

instruments.label: POWER CH B
instruments.what: Power channel B, from the ionisation chambers, in percent of nominal.
instruments.range: 0 to 150 %, red above the 120 % power trip
instruments.modelled: As the decider is given it: the reading of the run's sensor view at this tick.

instruments.label: DEMAND
instruments.what: The demanded power in percent of nominal.
instruments.modelled: As the decider is given it: the reading of the run's sensor view at this tick.

instruments.label: ORM PRINTOUT
instruments.what: The reactivity margin of the last printout of the unit computer, in rod equivalents.
instruments.range: 0 to 30; the operating rule is a minimum of 15 (red below)
instruments.modelled: As the decider is given it: the reading of the run's sensor view at this tick.

instruments.label: RODS MEAN
instruments.what: The mean of the 211 rod position indicators.
instruments.modelled: As the decider is given it: the reading of the run's sensor view at this tick.

instruments.label: DRUM LVL L
instruments.what: Left steam separator drum level.
instruments.range: -50 to +50 cm; the demo trips the reactor when the level is more than 45 cm out
instruments.modelled: As the decider is given it: the reading of the run's sensor view at this tick.

instruments.label: CORE FLOW
instruments.what: The core flow meters, in percent of nominal.
instruments.range: 0 to 150 %; below 55 % at power the demo trips
instruments.modelled: As the decider is given it: the reading of the run's sensor view at this tick.

instruments.label: DRUM P L
instruments.what: Left steam separator drum pressure.
instruments.modelled: As the decider is given it: the reading of the run's sensor view at this tick.

instruments.label: HEAT BAL
instruments.what: The heat-balance power, in percent of nominal; it lags the chambers.
instruments.range: 200 to 1600 C; nominal 750, trip above 1200, damage above 1500
instruments.modelled: As the decider is given it: the reading of the run's sensor view at this tick.

instruments.label: DRUM P R
instruments.what: Right steam separator drum pressure.
instruments.modelled: As the decider is given it: the reading of the run's sensor view at this tick.

instruments.label: STEAM HDR
instruments.what: Main steam header pressure.
instruments.modelled: As the decider is given it: the reading of the run's sensor view at this tick.

instruments.label: FEEDWATER
instruments.what: Feedwater flow, in percent of nominal.
instruments.modelled: As the decider is given it: the reading of the run's sensor view at this tick.

instruments.label: DRUM LVL R
instruments.what: Right steam separator drum level.
instruments.modelled: As the decider is given it: the reading of the run's sensor view at this tick.

instruments.label: MODEL RISK
instruments.what: The decision model's own expected risk score for the current state, from 1 lowest risk to 5 highest risk.
instruments.range: 1 to 5; dark when no model has answered
instruments.modelled: model_risk of each feed row: the expected value of the model's risk answer. A feed with no model leaves it null and the needle rests.

instruments.label: POWER
instruments.what: Strip recorder of true power and both channels.
instruments.modelled: P, chA, chB of the most recent feed rows.

instruments.label: PRESS / FEEDWATER
instruments.what: Strip recorder of fuel temperature (0 to 1600 C) and steam pressure (0 to 12 MPa), both drawn on a 0 to 100 scale.
instruments.modelled: Tf and p of the most recent feed rows.

instruments.label: ORM / ROD BANK
instruments.what: Strip recorder of the operational reactivity margin (0 to 30) and mean rod insertion (0 to 100 %), both on a 0 to 100 scale.
instruments.modelled: orm and the mean of rods of the most recent feed rows.

instruments.label: DECIDER
instruments.what: The decision display: the decision model's latest decision with the probability it gave each answer, the action it chose, when the action was applied and the desk log line it wrote, and the scenario events.
instruments.modelled: decisions[] of the feed: answers.<question>.scores with the model id, chosen action and when it took effect. Nothing here is generated by the viewer.

instruments.label: ORM TERMINAL
instruments.what: The reactivity-margin computer terminal on the engineer's desk: the last printed margin and the true margin, in rod equivalents, against the operating minimum.
instruments.modelled: orm_printed (the slow printout) and orm (true) of the current feed row, and scram.

instruments.label: AZ-5 ACTIVE
instruments.what: Lit while the emergency shutdown is running.

instruments.label: ORM < 15
instruments.text: the last ORM printout is below 15 rod equivalents
instruments.what: Reactivity margin below the operating minimum.

instruments.label: POWER > 120%
instruments.text: a power channel reads above 120 % of nominal
instruments.what: Power trip condition.

instruments.label: LOW CORE FLOW
instruments.text: the core flow meters read below 80 % of nominal
instruments.what: The demo's low-flow annunciator window.

instruments.label: HIGH PRESSURE
instruments.text: a drum pressure reads above 7.6 MPa
instruments.what: The demo's high-pressure annunciator window.

instruments.label: CH A/B DISAGREE
instruments.text: power channels A and B differ by more than 15 points
instruments.what: The two power channels disagree.

instruments.label: POWER < DEMAND
instruments.text: the heat-balance power is more than 10 points under the demand
instruments.what: Power is below the demand.

instruments.label: AZ-5
instruments.what: The emergency protection button under its hinged guard. Pressing it drives every control rod in.
instruments.modelled: az5 of the sensor view: true while AZ-5 is pressed.

instruments.label: ROD POSITIONS
instruments.what: The round rod-position map: one cell per control rod (211), coloured from fully withdrawn (yellow) through green to fully inserted (red).
instruments.modelled: Each cell shows rods[i] of the feed row, the demo's own position of that rod in percent inserted. The cell order is the demo's: the 17 by 17 grid sorted by distance from the centre.

instruments.label: PROT DEFEATED
instruments.text: any protection in prot is DEFEATED
instruments.what: At least one protection signal is switched off.

instruments.label: AUTO REG
instruments.text: the automatic power regulator is on
instruments.what: Lit while the automatic regulator is on.

instruments.label: TG TEST
instruments.text: the turbine rundown test is running
instruments.what: Lit while the turbine rundown test runs.

instruments.label: PUMP 1
instruments.what: Lit while the pump speed is above 5 % of nominal.

instruments.label: PUMP 2
instruments.what: Lit while the pump speed is above 5 % of nominal.

instruments.what: Lit while the pump speed is above 5 % of nominal.

instruments.what: Lit while the pump speed is above 5 % of nominal.

instruments.label: PUMP 7
instruments.what: Lit while the pump speed is above 5 % of nominal.

instruments.label: PUMP 8
instruments.what: Lit while the pump speed is above 5 % of nominal.

instruments.label: DRUM TRIPS OFF
instruments.what: Lit when this protection has been switched off.

instruments.label: TG TRIP OFF
instruments.what: Lit when this protection has been switched off.

instruments.label: ECCS OFF
instruments.what: Lit when this protection has been switched off.

instruments.label: DRUM LEVEL
instruments.text: a drum level reads outside plus or minus 45 cm
instruments.what: A drum level reading is outside plus or minus 45 cm.
